description.zh: 导入号码时返回的批次号
description.en: The batch ID returned when phone numbers are imported.

description.zh: 开始外呼日期，只可查询最近30天的日期，格式:2020-03-06 10:10:10
description.en: The start date of outbound calls. You can query data only within the last 30 days. Format: 2020-03-06 10:10:10.

description.zh: 结束外呼时间，只可查一天的数据，开始外呼日期和结束外呼日期是同一天的不同时间点。 格式支持 2020-03-06 10:10:10
description.en: The end time of outbound calls. You can query data for only one day. The start call date and end call date must be different time points on the same day. Format: 2020-03-06 10:10:10.

description.zh:
如“C”，则精准查询意向标签为C的数据；
若查询多个意向则["A","B","C”]；
description.en: The intent tag used to filter records. For example, if you set this parameter to "C", only records with intent tag C are returned. To query multiple intent tags, specify them as ["A","B","C"].

description.zh: 需要精确查询的号码，,支持批量 最大1000个号码
description.en: The phone numbers to query. You can specify up to 1000 numbers for exact match.

description.zh: 每页外呼记录数,正整数，默认10000
description.en: The number of outbound call records per page. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 10000.

title.zh: 行业版-AI批量任务查询外呼记录
title.en: Query outbound call records for an industry edition AI batch task

descriptions.zh: 行业版AI批量任务查询外呼记录
descriptions.en: Queries outbound call records for an industry edition AI batch task.
